user_instruction: 通过阶段四的5个配置都参与测试集验证

warmup.state: feature history only; no pre-test orders, fills or position-state carry

account.strategy_state: initial registered state; no development-state carry
account.end_valuation: BAR_CLOSE; leave final position open, no synthetic close

parameter_robustness: reuse disclosed development conclusion; no test-sample parameter perturbations or optimization; no claim of sample-out parameter robustness
decision_rule: Report all five; do not reorder by test performance. Among those passing both standard five gates and declared pressure gates, recommend the first in frozen training order; user decides subsequent technical inspection and freezing.
joint_test_disclosure: Five correlated prespecified candidates share one test window; no claim of five independent samples or multiplicity-corrected significance. Filtering by test pass is disclosed selection within this fixed family.
feedback_rule: No retuning, changed thresholds, replacement candidates or repeated attempts until passing. Further development based on these observations makes this period seen data.

diagnostics.short_sample: report unavailable without extending into training/future; report-only
diagnostics.uncertainty: paired annual excess-return interval; report-only, not an added gate
